description: This Java class 'DefaultOAuthConfig' provides the default implementation of OAuth configuration, including loading issuer information from configuration files, and exposing OAuth protocol and issuer mappings.

classes.name: DefaultOAuthConfig
classes.description: Implements OAuthConfig, loads OAuth settings from configuration, and provides access to protocol and issuer mappings.

classes.name: SubjectIssuerCollector
classes.description: A collector class to convert configuration entries into a map of SubjectIssuer to String.

methods.name: loadIssuers
methods.description: Loads issuer entries from configuration and converts them into a map of SubjectIssuer to String.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultOAuthConfig from a given Config object.
